title: Master 10-Point Quality Gate Checklist
checklist: 1. Was this change backed by live empirical facts (CDP inspection / verified logs)?
2. Was a formal diagnostic report presented before editing any production code?
3. Did the user explicitly approve the changes in developer mode?
4. Are all engine files (core/*.py) 100% free of candidate PII (Guardrail P1)?
5. Are platform changes isolated (Naukri does not break LinkedIn, and vice versa)?
6. Are modal scrolls and click events properly isolated to active dialog containers?
7. Does duplicate detection account for multi-stint tenures across different years?
8. Are all documentation files (docs/*.md, walkthrough.md) completely up to date?
10. Is the master_agent directory strictly ignored in .gitignore?
